description:
Get the top-level comments of a YouTube video, each with its like and reply count.

        Costs 1 credit per 100 comments returned, replies included, rounded up (minimum 1): up
        to 100 comments cost 1 credit, 101-200 cost 2. Videos with comments turned off cost
        nothing.

        Args:
            video_id: YouTube video ID (11 characters)
            limit: Number of comments to fetch (default 20, max 500)
            sort: "top" (default) or "new" (newest first)
            include_replies: Also fetch the replies of each comment (default false)
            replies_per_comment: With include_replies, most replies per comment (1-100,
                default 10)
name: get_comments
title: Get comments
